steps: livegap and base installer source-pinned self-tests passed
model executable crosschecked Python unsigned arithmetic and independent bit-serial division
exhaustive i8 value/zero-divisor trap and downstream-live-SSA states
finite i64 targeted edge and pseudorandom values

observable_semantics.widths: i8 exhaustive (all 256x256 x/y, four rotation constants); i64 sampled (2,169 x/y pairs, five rotations)
observable_semantics.definedness: zero-divisor traps at first instruction; same modeled trap order
observable_semantics.overflow: unsigned fixed-width modulo 2^width multiplication and subtraction
observable_semantics.live_values: quotient, intermediate multiplication, its rotl use, remainder, and a combined downstream result
observable_semantics.negative_operands: wrong multiplication operand, reversed subtraction and different dividend yield concrete witnesses
observable_semantics.not_modeled: poison/undefined CLIF, flags, physical registers/ABI, trap-code/source-location metadata, arbitrary SSA scheduling, target-specific machine behavior

limitations: Source matcher static anchors and installer self-tests establish only narrow source intention, not semantic equivalence to real compiled Cranelift.
No full i64 SMT proof from this work; earlier separately evidenced arithmetic proofs must not be conflated.
Zero-divisor trap ordering is simulated; exact Cranelift trap code/provenance isn't rechecked here.
No actual AOT native-code change, performance speedup, target register-state or general compiler-pass soundness qualified by this model.
Previous per-function 9-byte savings remain separate experimental machine evidence, not derived from this model.
Do not upstream the compiler patch solely on this receipt.
next_engineering_gate: Independent Cranelift pass-level SSA/register/flag/trap-code correctness and realistic target workload value, preferably matching actual source to model/VeriISLE with authoritative specifications.
